# Deploy

Server need key. Key live in dir. Mount dir, not file. Rotate key, no restart needed.
Health check split two. Liveness say alive. Readiness say dependency. Duplicate order
not count twice. Log show no secret ever. Build image fast. Layer cache good. Only
source layer rebuild. Compose bring up stack. Mock upstream serve fixture. Smoke test
hit every tool. Doc command all run once. Agent call tool. Tool do work on server.
Server do math, model never. Rule fixed in code, not parameter. Unknown store reject.
Negative quantity reject. Audit line write on every action. Reviewer read repo, see
truth. Time one hour only. Stop build at minute thirty eight. Verify then. Walkthrough
five minute. Upload after stop record.
